_doc: RixPicks league registry - single source of truth for all league wiring. Every script reads this. A league reaches FULL STANDARD when: ingestion (espn), odds routing (odds_api and/or kalshi), card rendering, pulse, grading path all verified live. J-049A: odds_api is only queried for leagues carded that day (manifest-gated, 16 credits/day cap).

MLS.note: logos via ESPN meta id-URL, not abbr CDN

NWSL.note: no odds-API coverage; Kalshi + Polymarket routing only

futures.note: per-event outrights; majors via odds-API futures keys

ATP.note: odds-API tennis keys are per-tournament when covered (currently none active). ESPN match scores at events[].groupings[].competitions[] (athlete names, no logos)

WTA.note: per-tournament odds keys; Kalshi match markets live. ESPN match scores at events[].groupings[].competitions[]

NASCAR.note: ESPN slug verified live (nascar-premier = Cup). No odds-API coverage; Kalshi + Polymarket | individuals have no ESPN logos - name-rendered rows (verified 9/25)

UFC.note: slate-driven | individuals have no ESPN logos - name-rendered rows (verified 9/25)

Boxing.note: ESPN has no boxing scoreboard API; slate verified live via odds-API boxing_boxing (53 bouts with h2h, 9/25). Kalshi KXBOXINGFIGHT series exists, opens per card
